title: Read: what does the DDPM draw?
summary:
From the weights alone, with no tools or forward passes, Claude Opus 5.5 named the right shape in 9 of 15 attempts and drew a judge-recognised correct shape in 15 of 15; on hidden-unit-permuted copies it was right in 3 of 6, and it called 2 of 2 untrained networks untrained (total API cost $11.93).

Caveats: 2 label hits come from descriptions that answer 'handwritten digits' and only mention a ring-like '0', so in substance no circle run named a circle. 7 drawing hits win the judge's argmax by less than 0.1 IoU (digit-like drawings, not shapes), so the drawing metric is too lenient to count as evidence.

table.caption: Per shape: text label (primary), drawing judged by template IoU (secondary), permutation control, mean confidence (main), and drawing style.
rows: Nothing coherent: weights look untrained (both runs)
